environment.description: ASP.NET Core 7 API deployed as a container on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with public internet access. The ALB target group forwards all traffic on port 443 to the container. No authentication middleware is configured in the application. The container runs with default IAM task role (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ecs-task-default) which has broad S3 and Secrets Manager read access.
